title: VeloraOS 1.10.54 - iOS UX Polish
releaseNotes: Rebuilds standalone mobile Chat around a compact native-style conversation header with no wasted top space.
Moves image and camera attachments into the message composer and adds native-style attachment actions.
Adds native conversation actions for new chat, rename, Chat controls, notifications and delete.
Adds in-app rename and destructive confirmation sheets instead of browser prompts in the installed PWA.
Groups conversation history into Today, Yesterday and Previous and adds an edge-swipe drawer gesture.
Refines keyboard, safe-area, composer and bottom-tab sizing and adds an iPad standalone layout.
